inputs.name: atime

inputs.description: AS7341 ADC gain factor, 0.5 to 512 (the sensor's code is 0 to 10)
inputs.name: gain

outputs.name: wavelengths

outputs.description: Eight channel readings returned by the sensor, in arbitrary units
outputs.name: intensities

outputs.description: Total integration time computed from ASTEP and ATIME
outputs.name: integration_ms

adjusts.description: RGB color of the one NeoPixel, in the order red, green, blue, each byte 0 to 255

limit.reason: the MQTT firmware for the same Pico asserts each of R, G and B is between 0 and 255; the nonwireless firmware writes the tuple to the NeoPixel without its own assertion

adjusts.name: color

facts.text: The nonwireless host helper opens the serial port at 115200 baud and writes set_color(R, G, B) and read_sensor(astep, atime, gain) lines, reading one reply line and one extra line
Talker appends CR FF to the command text, reads the echoed line, strips a '>>> ' prompt and raises ValueError when the echo differs
Talker.receive reads to a CR terminator and strips the line
The nonwireless Pico's set_color writes one NeoPixel on pin 28; read_sensor sets ASTEP, ATIME and gain and returns every channel
The nonwireless firmware's startup sequence ends with set_color(0, 0, 0), so the LED is off after boot
The eight AS7341 channels are ch410, ch440, ch470, ch510, ch550, ch583, ch620 and ch670
The nominal channel centres are 410, 440, 470, 510, 550, 583, 620 and 670 nm
Sensor.all_channels runs an F1F4CN and an F5F8CN measurement and returns the eight values f1 to f8
The total integration time is (ASTEP + 1) * (ATIME + 1) * 2.78 / 1000 ms
The host asserts atime 0 to 255, astep 0 to 65534 and gain 0.5 to 512
The AS7341 gain code runs from 0 to 10 and maps to the factors 0.5, 1, 2, ..., 512
The MQTT firmware for the same Pico asserts that R, G and B are each between 0 and 255
The nonwireless firmware parser reads one line, splits it on parentheses and dispatches set_color and read_sensor
The nonwireless firmware's read_sensor branch unpacks two arguments and then calls a three-argument read_sensor

safe_state.description: NeoPixel off: set_color(0, 0, 0) is sent through the serial link
